description:
You are one of several event organisers choosing a caterer for a large conference. Each organiser has gathered different tasting notes, references, and logistics details.

The options are:
- Caterer A (Negardra Ithmirdra)
- Caterer B (Dragaryer Ansmiryer)
- Caterer C (Vasan Vanol)
- Caterer D (Vatho Ozthoso)

Exactly one option is best overall. Which caterer should be booked? Your notes are incomplete: other participants hold information you do not have.
